name: daemon-idle-activatable
title: packagekitd installed but idle (D-Bus activated)
description: The normal state on this machine: packagekitd is not running (it exits after ShutdownTimeout, 300 s) but the bus can start it (its D-Bus service file is installed). NameHasOwner is false and ListActivatableNames lists PackageKit; NO_AUTO_START calls get NameHasNoOwner (design 4.7: "the daemon is gone"); the first call without the flag starts the daemon through the private bus's service directory, and the call is then answered. After SetDaemon(false) (the idle exit) the next call starts a new daemon with a new unique name. A service that treats "not running" as "not installed" fails here; daemon-absent is the uninstalled case.
